title: Hotel Website (Sample)
description: A sample hotel website supporting Japanese, English, Chinese, and Korean to accommodate inbound travelers. Built with Astro for fast performance and multilingual SEO, while also providing a multilingual CMS, automated translation, and multilingual search to simplify day-to-day operations.
overviewDesc: This sample hotel website was created with international visitors in mind, supporting four languages. Hotel staff can update website content and announcements through an easy-to-use CMS, while translation and deployment are automated to minimize maintenance work and keep operating costs close to zero.

highlights.title: 4-Language Support × Multilingual SEO
highlights.desc: Supports Japanese, English, Chinese, and Korean. Astro's static site generation creates independent pages per language, achieving both fast load times and strong search engine visibility across all four languages.

highlights.title: Auto-Translation + Manual Override
highlights.desc: Updates made in Japanese are automatically translated and applied to all other language versions. Each language can also be manually edited afterward, combining the efficiency of automation with the quality of human review.

highlights.title: Near-Zero Cost × Automated Deployment
highlights.desc: Infrastructure and CMS costs are kept close to zero by combining free services and open-source tools. Content approved in the CMS is automatically published via GitHub Actions — no manual deployment needed.

timeline.desc: Organized pages around what visitors actually need — rooms, hot springs, dining, and access — with a clear, responsive layout that conveys the natural scenery of Lake Toya.
Used Astro's static generation to create independent pages for each of the four languages. Visitors can switch languages without losing context, and all versions are indexed by search engines.
Integrated Sveltia CMS so staff can update content without technical knowledge. Built a GitHub Actions pipeline that automatically translates Japanese updates into the other three languages.
Added site-wide search covering rooms, facilities, and announcements in all four languages, giving visitors a smooth browsing experience regardless of their language.
Fully automated publishing via GitHub Actions. Combined free-tier services to keep infrastructure and CMS running costs at virtually zero — practical for small hotels and independent businesses.
